definitions: Either of the two soft, protruding organs on the upper front of a woman's body that secrete milk after childbirth.
The front part of a person's or animal's body between the neck and the abdomen.
The part of a garment that covers the chest.
The seat of emotions or feelings; the heart.
examples: The mother held the baby to her breast.
A robin with a red breast.
He clutched his hand to his breast.
